salient_x: In a meeting you hear the project you spent months on may be cancelled. The room goes quiet. Nobody looks at you.
salient_xs: In a meeting you hear the project you spent months on may be cancelled. The room goes quiet. Nobody looks at you.
They confirm the project will be cancelled. They say the work was good. You are not asked to speak.
In front of the whole team the project is cancelled and given to someone else. They say your effort did not enter the decision. You are not allowed to speak.
You start to answer. They cut you off. After the meeting nobody stays. The decision is already final.
Walking out you see it was never in doubt. The meeting was a formality. You were not allowed a reply. The rejection is complete.
salient_y: In a meeting you hear the project you spent months on may be kept as a reference.
salient_ys: In a meeting you hear the project you spent months on may be kept as a reference.
They confirm the project will be kept. They name the quality of your work. You are asked to speak.
In front of the whole team the project is kept as the reference. They use what you already built.
You answer. They listen. After the meeting people stay and talk about next steps.
Walking out you see it was never in doubt. The meeting was to keep the work. You had a chance to reply.
